as_told.title: Levitating sphere in the Off-World Technology area
as_told.place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

plain: At the Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research base in Indiana, a metallic sphere the size of a basketball floated in the air above a podium. A man named Randy Anderson tells Michels he saw it himself in 2014; in another telling he dates it only to the 2010s and places it in what he calls the Off-World Technology area. If true, it would mean the Navy holds technology that defies gravity.
